title: Prompts
excerpt: Prompts enable servers to define reusable prompt templates and workflows that clients can easily surface to users and LLMs. They provide a powerful way to standardize and share common LLM interactions. Prompts are designed to be user controlled , meaning they are exposed from servers to clients with the intention of the user being able to explicitly select them for use.
